page.layout: One title page, single column, centred. Top: printed title in large type, with a smaller italic line and the author lines below. Middle: a decorative ornament (printer's device). Lower: a block of small italic lines, then the imprint at the foot.

main_text.l: Philosophorum publicis, privatisque commentariis excerpta, atque ad veram Methodi Leges revocata:

page.notes: The title is set in mixed type: spaced capitals, large capitals and italic. The large title and the author's name are partly blurred by show-through from the reverse side, so some letters are doubtful and marked [?]. The lines in the lower block are too faint to read and are marked illegible. The printer's device in the centre is an ornament with no text. Ink on the page is faded.
